name: D-glass-grove
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. One original macOS app icon concept for a Git client, exploring GROVE meaning a small group of trees and Git branching. The SYMBOL MUST clearly combine a grove of THREE trees with branching paths. Three staggered upright trunks, center slightly taller, each forking into broad rounded Y-shaped limbs; their rounded crowns overlap into one compact woodland silhouette. Visible open negative spaces between trunks, rooted on a subtle common curved baseline. Do not draw a literal landscape. Render the tree shapes as thick translucent colored glass: mint turquoise front tree, cobalt blue left tree, lavender right tree, richer color at overlaps, restrained ivory edge highlights and soft depth. Full square pale frosted gray-green background, no baked rounded tile corners, no surrounding scene. Centered symbol occupying 72% of canvas, clean readable silhouette at 32px. Style guidance only from premium colorful overlapping macOS app icons, do not copy their symbols. No arrows, no X, no letters, no wordmark, no mascot, no unrelated objects. The subject is unmistakably a compact grove with visible branching trunks.

name: E-folded-grove
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. One original macOS app icon for a Git and worktree client. Subject: GROVE, a small cluster of trees, combined with Git branch topology. Create a compact grove of three stylized trees with clearly visible upright trunks and forked Y branches, center tree taller, outer trees shorter. Crowns are broad geometric folded leaf-shaped planes, turquoise and cobalt blue with restrained lavender folded faces; trunks deep blue, bold and visible. Branches fork organically up into the crowns; subtle shared root connects the grove. Emphasize the group of trees, not a single leaf, bird, ribbon or abstract swoosh. Premium folded-paper material, crisp large planes, modest thickness, soft contact shadow. Edge-to-edge warm white square background; no rounded tile mask or scene. Symbol fills 72% of canvas with generous margins. Original silhouette, controlled detail, readable at Dock size. No text, no initials, no arrows, no robot, no conventional standalone Git logo. One centered icon only.

name: F-sculpted-grove
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. ONE original premium macOS app icon for a Git worktree client, subject combining GROVE (a small group of trees) and Git branches. A compact upright grove of three sculpted trees, tallest centered, small trees flanking it, their thick trunks visibly fork into Y branches beneath compact angular tree crowns. Connected roots form a subtle common base. Rounded geometric mineral-like crowns, faceted broad planes in vivid violet, lavender and a restrained blue accent. Bold clearly visible lavender branching trunks. The silhouette must read as several trees growing together, not a single crystal, mountain, flame, letter or mascot. Sculpted satin material with soft directional light and gentle depth, strong graphic simplicity, dark charcoal full square background edge to edge. No rounded tile mask, no pedestal, no scenic forest, no particles or neon bloom. 72% canvas occupancy and generous margins. No text, no letters, no arrows, no small circuitry. One centered icon artwork only.
